name: Tenor
long_description:
Tenor lets service businesses grow revenue without growing headcount. Our AI agents run entire jobs across existing tools, with persistent memory, budgets, guardrails, and measurable outcomes. They learn which decisions produce better results and improve over time.

For one customer, Tenor completed 1,500 hours of work in a month and increased revenue by 30%, with zero new hires. We signed $504k in ARR in four weeks and are already profitable.
one_liner: The infrastructure for service businesses to build and scale with AI
